summary.note: Revenue and expenses are in DIFFERENT currencies and are deliberately not combined. Expenses are AUD (ledger currency). All revenue to date is USD store proceeds as reported by RevenueCat, so total_revenue (AUD) is 0 and net excludes revenue. No FX rate has been applied because inventing one would make the receipt less true, not more; reconcile against App Store Connect payment reports when available.
